replaces: On /features/start-page: the single Billboard hero capture (billboard-v1.38.0, docs/website-captures-v1.38.0.json) becomes a carousel of these 26 customized Start Pages showing the clock’s Font & color (F54), new in v1.41.0. The v1.38.0 files stay in place with their ledger; the layout gallery below still shows them. The wallpaper and layout galleries below it move from the v1.38.0 captures to v1.41.0 retakes (galleryMethod).

source.artifact: Public release asset Blanc-1.41.0-arm64.dmg from https://github.com/bnfy/blanc/releases/tag/v1.41.0, checked against the Sigstore-verified SHA256SUMS and mounted read-only; the installed /Applications/Blanc.app and its profile were not used
source.verification: On October 21, 2026, Gatekeeper accepted the mounted app (Notarized Developer ID); the release report records strict deep codesign, the pinned leaf certificate and the stapled ticket for this DMG. It launched as a separate instance in a disposable profile per state.

settings.profile: Isolated disposable user-data directory per state

method: BLANC_PACKAGED_EXECUTABLE=<mounted DMG>/Blanc.app/Contents/MacOS/Blanc BLANC_CAPTURE_IMAGES=<the samples below, with trim, crop and padding> node scripts/capture-installed-clock.mjs, under caffeinate -d. Each state is a disposable profile seeded with the shared Start Page fixtures (four sample Favorites, their visits, a weekly blocked total of 328), lastRunVersion 1.41.0, a dismissed Patron callout, and the clock style and wallpaper as the app stores them (settings.json newtabClock* and newtabWallpaper*). The released importer runs only behind the native file picker, so the fixture writes the stored image and wallpaper.json as the importer would. Everything drawn is the released app’s own rendering. Each is a native window capture (screencapture -l, 2560×1600) resized to 1440×900 in sRGB with a same-size WebP (quality 85). The page’s pointer is parked in empty space so no tile shows hover controls.

shownOn: site/src/pages/features/start-page.astro (hero fan, components/StartPageGallery.astro, data in site/src/data/start-page-designs.json; the wallpaper and layout galleries)
galleryMethod: The wallpaper gallery (start-page-image*, start-page-color*) and the layout gallery (billboard, ledger, shelf, tally, mahjong) on /features/start-page are retaken from the same mounted public v1.41.0 DMG with the scripts and settings behind docs/website-captures-v1.38.0.json: BLANC_CAPTURE_VERSION=1.41.0 BLANC_CAPTURE_SCALE=2 node scripts/capture-installed-start-page.mjs (2880×1800 page captures, WebP companions at quality 85) and BLANC_CAPTURE_VERSION=1.41.0 BLANC_CAPTURE_IMAGE=<Wheat Field with Cypresses> BLANC_CAPTURE_WASH=spotlight BLANC_CAPTURE_TRIM=0.03 node scripts/capture-installed-custom-wallpaper.mjs (1440×900 window captures, Sky with the Gradient fill). They replace the v1.38.0 shots, which keep their files and ledger for the pages that still show them.
